| description = 

There are technically two versions of this mob with different appearances: The Antonica Deathfist centurions with grey skin and golden garb (as seen in photo), and the Faydwer Crushbone centurions with blue skin and dark yellow garb. The Deathfist centurions in Antonica drop [[Deathfist Slashed Belt|Deathfist Slashed Belts]], while the Faydwer centurions drop [[Crushbone Belt|Crushbone Belts]]. These two varieties of orc also belong to different factions. This page is for ''Antonica'' orc centurions.
